report: World XI "Wrong answer", 2026-09-21: a CDM or CM slot said "Nobody from X matches that" for Manuel Ugarte, Sofyan Amrabat, Wataru Endo, Tyler Adams and PSG's Vitinha.
finding: public.player_market_values holds no Defensive Midfield rows for 2023, 2024 or 2025 (432 to 500 a year through 2022) and 46 hand written ones for 2026, so nearly every current defensive midfielder was missing from the 2026 snapshot every soccer game reads.
population: Transfermarkt's most valuable players list filtered to main position Defensive Midfield, all leagues, all 20 pages (the top 500 by value, EUR 140m down to EUR 2m), read 2026-09-28. The market value table has always carried the top 500 per position per year, so this is the same population the missing years would have held.
rule: Source A is Transfermarkt (club, main position, value, age, citizenship). Source B is FotMob's player data (club, birth date, the positions he has played, its own value estimate, country), a different host with its own data.
Identity: same name (or a spelling matched by hand, see note) and the same age on both hosts.
Club: both hosts name the same club. Spelling pairs that share no word were read by hand. A reserve or youth side never matches its first team.
Position: Transfermarkt's main position is Defensive Midfield and FotMob lists defensive midfield among the positions he has played.

Value: the stored figure is Transfermarkt's, times 1.08, the convention every other row follows. FotMob's estimate is a different model and runs lower (median ratio in valueBand), so it corroborates within a factor of three of that median rather than matching exactly. Outside the band, or with no FotMob figure, the row is held.

Nationality: Transfermarkt's first citizenship, the table's convention (one country, no slash), and FotMob must name the same country. World XI draws its slots by country, so this one is checked like the club.

A name the 2026 snapshot already carries is never written again: when the stored row is the same man (same club, or same nationality and an age within a year) he is listed under alreadyPresent; when it is a different man the row is held, except the two namesakes written on purpose and marked.
